headline: NYC's click-to-cancel subscription rule takes effect
summary: New York City's new click-to-cancel rule has taken effect, making it the first US city to require that canceling a subscription be as easy as signing up for one.

claims.statement: NYC's click-to-cancel rule took effect, requiring businesses to make canceling a subscription as easy as signing up.

sources.quote: NYC is now the first city in America that bans sketchy subscriptions
the city's click-to-cancel rule has taken effect, which requires businesses to make it as easy to cancel a subscription as it is to sign up
NYC's click-to-cancel rule is now in effect to save consumers from subscription hell
